summary: Preserved the base's valid opt-in Mooncake index batching and rejected candidate b8902dbde7a9d707fc5729883551ed082c110baa's global 1024-index default. The candidate's mechanics pass focused tests, but 1024 was validated only for GLM-5.2-NVFP4 and its KV layout; neither the original FP8 workload nor its H100 multi-node Mooncake/DeepEP topology was reproduced. Added a failing-before/passing-after regression requiring the model-dependent limit to remain opt-in.

tests.command: exact-candidate source assertion that SGLANG_MOONCAKE_MAX_TRANSFER_BATCH_INDICES defaults to 0
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before: exact candidate b8902dbde7a9d707fc5729883551ed082c110baa sets the global default to 1024, violating the opt-in invariant required while model-independent safety is unproven.
Passing-after: 6 tests and 3 subtests passed, including the new default-is-opt-in regression and existing ordered slicing, boundary, failure, device-index, and custom-memory-pool coverage.
The candidate's own 6 tests and 3 subtests passed, confirming its batching mechanics while not validating the original deployment or a model-independent default.

gpu_execution.evidence: Torch reported one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2. The issue requires NVIDIA H100 multi-node Mooncake/RDMA and DeepEP behavior; no unrelated GPU smoke is presented as issue evidence.

remaining_limitations: The original glm5.2-fp8 deployment was not reproduced before or after the candidate; upstream PR 32758 reports that its failure was not reproduced on FP8 at concurrency 8.
The original two 2-node prefill instances and 4-node/32-rank decode topology with H100, Mooncake/RDMA, DSA, HiCache, HiSparse, and DeepEP remains untested.
A source-issue follow-up reports freezing specifically with --moe-a2a-backend deepep; changing Mooncake transfer batch size does not establish that this path is fixed.
The 1024 value was measured on GLM-5.2-NVFP4 and its per-index byte size. Safety and efficacy for other models and KV layouts remain unverified.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
